title: 2-Year Treasury Note auction — the only leg of the January month-end block that sells before the FOMC convenes
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 for this initial research (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and decompressed stream-by-stream to 909 text tokens. Row reads verbatim `2-Year  NOTE / Announcement Thursday, January 21, 2027 / Auction Monday, January 25, 2027 / Settlement Monday, February 01, 2027`, with NO trailing `R` — and the same PDF's legend reads `R --denotes reopening`, so the absence is Treasury's own new-issue marker, not an inference. Same fetch, same announcement: `5-Year NOTE` 01-26, `2-Year FRN` 01-27, `7-Year NOTE` 01-28, all settling 02-01, plus `Holiday - Monday, January 18, 2027 - Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.` Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2027-01-21 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event's never-assessed initial research, after reading the one prior proposal (`from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-21`, 2026-09-09), per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-2y-note-2027-01-25.md. SLOT: the 2027 FOMC calendar (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct this session, HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) puts the January meeting on 2027-01-26/27, so this auction is D-2 from the decision and D-1 from the meeting's first day — the only coupon in the block that prices before the committee sits. The same page states each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting before it. ONE CORRECTION TO THE PROPOSAL, and it is the load-bearing one for anyone re-running this series: the `robust filter` the proposal recommends (intersecting `security_term` AND `original_security_term`) is WRONG — it drops 11 genuine monthly 2-Year new issues, INCLUDING 2026-01-26, which is the single closest comparator to this event (January, D-2, $69B, b/c 2.75). Proof computed this session: the correct filter (`security_term: '2-Year'` + `floating_rate: 'No'` + `inflation_index_security: 'No'`) returns 320 rows, zero duplicate CUSIPs, and exactly one auction per calendar month 2000-01 through 2026-08 with a single two-sided exception — no auction in 2015-10 and two in 2015-11 — which is the debt-ceiling postponement, the October sale rescheduled to 2015-11-04. Adding `original_security_term` opens 11 holes, 10 of which are the only 2-Year in their month, each carrying its era's exact new-issue size ($69B 2026, $40B 2019, $26B 2015-17, $10B 2000). SIZE EXPECTATION $69B is DEDUCED, never published: it is 29 consecutive prints (2024-04-23 -> 2026-08-25, zero deviations) plus sb0590's verbatim flat guidance; sb0590's anticipated-size grid runs May-26 through Oct-26 and stops, so no Treasury document names January 2027 today. The published figure arrives at the 2027-01-21 announcement; the 2027-02-03-ish refunding is outside every schedule this session could source.
